description: Blocks any subagent spawn (Task/Agent tool) whose prompt does not carry the [EPISTEMIC-DISCIPLINE v1] preamble or an explicit [EPISTEMIC-EXEMPT: <reason>] tag. This is the forcing function that makes the epistemic-discipline rules apply to ALL subagents instead of being prose: a spawn without the preamble physically fails (exit 2) with instructions to add it. Deterministic literal-marker check (no semantic grepping, no false positives from content). Fail-open by design: any parse/runtime error in the hook itself allows the spawn (exit 0) — the gate must never brick agent work because of its own bugs. Escape hatch: include [EPISTEMIC-EXEMPT: <reason>] in the prompt for trivial mechanical agents (pure search/fetch); the tag is auditable in transcripts.
